metadata.title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87341198 with a selected-norm leaf
metadata.description: Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re(s) > 43670599/50000000 = 0.87341198, principal pole excluded. A new estimate (R1) bounds the energy of rows with a heavy prime-slot block, for cuts K between 0.500001 and 3/4: the rows are split into sixth-root classes, and each class is bounded by Joseph Bebel's selected sextic norm and by the baseline's reflected radial engine. This lets the leaf of Sil's cube-free native step use K = 501/1000 instead of 3/4, so the line of native faces continues from the fourth-power face G(99999/100000, 93/25, 3/50) down to G(99999/100000, 401/200, 13399/100000). The faces are proved by induction along the line, without a list of steps or a density chain. arvi-density's return is retuned to the end face (three windows). The modules of joint-detector-fine-chain that the selected norm needs, and the part of arvi-density's return that reads its constants, are copied into this package. Builds on OpenAI, Hailey Collet, Sil, Jacob Sussman, Joseph Bebel and our earlier work; inherited notices and licenses are retained. The research and Lean development were AI-assisted.

pr.title: arvi-selected-leaf: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.87341198
pr.body: QRH-Result: arvi-selected-leaf QRH-Bound: 43670599/50000000 QRH-Decimal: 0.87341198 Dirichlet nonvanishing for Re(s) > 43670599/50000000 = 0.87341198, principal pole excluded. The current best is 0.87387234 (#94). The new estimate is in `R1/`. On rows whose prime-slot block has mass at least Z^{K w(D)}, for K between 0.500001 and 3/4, the energy is split over sixth-root classes. Each class is bounded by the selected sextic norm of #93 and by the baseline's reflected radial engine. With this, the leaf of Sil's cube-free native step can use K = 501/1000 instead of 3/4, so the native line of faces continues down to G(99999/100000, 401/200, 13399/100000). Both lines are proved by induction along the line, with no list of steps and no density chain. arvi-density's return is retuned to that face (three windows). `JointDetector/` holds the 114 modules of #93 that the selected norm needs; only their import paths changed, because they live under `Candidate/` there. `Return/` holds the 14 modules of arvi-density's return that read its constants; only the imports and the constants changed. No existing submission is modified. Checked locally: the 179 modules build in about 12 minutes on 4 cores with the dependencies cached, `Candidate.bound` depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, the generated wrapper compiles, and the metadata, dependency graph and repository tests pass. ### Proof submission requirements - [x] My submission directory is `YYYY-MM-DD-`, with the original PR creation date in UTC appearing only once.
